invented_detail: In {region}, the source contains {source_feature}. Keep that form at its original width and contrast. Do not add {unwanted_feature} there. Preserve the source's surrounding features.
missing_detail: Preserve {feature} in {region}, including its original count, location and outline. Resolve it clearly rather than merging it into the surrounding fill. Do not compensate by inventing detail elsewhere.
lost_grain: Restore the original grain in {region}, retaining its recognizable clusters, scale, direction and strength. This grain must remain visible when reduced to the original dimensions. Much finer unrelated noise does not replace it.
moved_feature: Keep {feature} in {region} at its exact source position, size and thickness. Preserve its original asymmetry and curvature. Do not straighten, regularise or symmetrise it.
colour_drift: Match the source's {region} locally. Preserve its {source_colour_description}; avoid the observed {drift_description}. Keep its internal light/dark relationships. Do not compensate by changing another part of the image.
hardened_fade: In {region}, retain the source's soft colour falloff across its full original width. Do not add a hard outline or narrow boundary. Keep the original centre brightness and footprint.
